sloka: एवम् उक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावण ।ततः पश्चात् इदम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् वाक्य कोविदः ॥३-३१-३९॥
transliteration: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa ।tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ ॥3-31-39॥

translations.english: Having thus been asked by Maricha, glorious Ravana, who was eloquent in speech, spoke to him :
